name: The Central Bank Junior — Setting the Rate When You Are Sixteen
description: Sit on the Monetary Policy Committee of the Banco Central de Costaria for two years. Make four sequential rate decisions across boom, lag, supply shock and the return to neutral, while learning that monetary policy is calibrated boldness, professional restraint, and credibility above all.
